adm_legendre_contract.convexity: The scalar Hamiltonian is locally strictly convex in the canonical momenta iff K_ADM>0 and Y0>0.
adm_legendre_contract.local_invertibility: The scalar Legendre map on the chosen slice is locally invertible iff K_ADM is nonzero and Y0 is nonzero.
adm_legendre_contract.momenta: pi_phi=sqrt(h) C v_phi and pi_chi=sqrt(h) Y0 v_chi
adm_legendre_contract.slice_warning: C>0 and K_inv>0 make the phi effective metric Lorentzian, but a chosen ADM normal is also a valid phi time covector only when K_ADM>0.

canonical_hamiltonian_contract.claim_limit: A canonical Hamiltonian formula and momentum convexity conditions do not prove that the Hamiltonian is bounded below; the P, V, background, boundary, and matter sectors remain decisive.
canonical_hamiltonian_contract.stress_energy_identity: H_perp_s/sqrt(h)=T_s_munu n^mu n^nu exactly for T_s_munu=C d_mu phi d_nu phi+Y0 d_mu chi d_nu chi+g_munu L_s.

geometry_and_action_contract.coefficient_definitions: C=P_X-Q Z_X, C_X=P_XX-Q Z_XX, K_inv=C+2X C_X, and K_ADM=C+v_phi^2 C_X
geometry_and_action_contract.normal_velocities: v_phi=n^mu d_mu phi=(dot(phi)-beta^i D_i phi)/N and v_chi=(dot(chi)-beta^i D_i chi)/N
geometry_and_action_contract.scalar_lagrangian: L_s=P(X)-V(phi)+Y0 X_chi-Q Z(X), with Q=m_chi^2 chi^2/2, Y0>0, and Z=(1+beta X^2)^2 for the illustrative gate
geometry_and_action_contract.scope: The Einstein-Hilbert and universal-matter sectors are bound predecessors but are not Legendre-transformed here; this package derives the scalar canonical block on an arbitrary spacelike ADM slice.
geometry_and_action_contract.spatial_gradient_norms: s_phi^2=h^ij D_i phi D_j phi and s_chi^2=h^ij D_i chi D_j chi

homogeneous_energy_contract.combined_timelike_bound: Where Z_X>0, H=Z_X+2X Z_XX>0, and -E_Z>0, simultaneous C>0, K_inv>0, and rho_s>0 require Q<min[P_X/Z_X,(P_X+2X P_XX)/H,rho_base/(-E_Z)].
homogeneous_energy_contract.energy_density: rho_s=2X P_X-P+V+Y0 X_chi+Q[Z-2X Z_X] on a homogeneous timelike background
homogeneous_energy_contract.high_u_warning: If rho_base approaches a finite positive constant, the energy ceiling scales as chi^2=O(X^-4), stricter than the O(X^-3) principal-coefficient ceilings; no finite asymptotic rho_base is assumed by the action.
homogeneous_energy_contract.illustrative_gate_factor: For Z=(1+u)^2 with u=beta X^2, E_Z=Z-2X Z_X=(1+u)(1-7u).
homogeneous_energy_contract.independence: Positive C, K_inv, and K_ADM do not by themselves imply positive rho_s; a designed numerical case preserves this separation.
homogeneous_energy_contract.positive_energy_bound: For u>1/7 and rho_base=2X P_X-P+V+Y0 X_chi>0, rho_s>0 requires Q<rho_base/[-E_Z], equivalently chi^2<2 rho_base/[m_chi^2(-E_Z)].
homogeneous_energy_contract.sign_transition: The gate contribution Q E_Z is nonnegative for 0<=u<=1/7 and negative for u>1/7.

limitations: The result is a scalar-block ADM Legendre transform; it does not Legendre-transform or prove positivity of the full Einstein-matter system.
Hamiltonian convexity in momenta is not a lower-bound proof for the total energy density.
The local slice conditions do not control lower-order instabilities, nonlinear cutoff, boundary flux, or global evolution.
The illustrative gate has a negative homogeneous energy contribution above u=1/7; the unspecified P and V sectors may compensate, so this is not an unconditional no-go.
No on-shell background, motion+lensing solution, Solar/GW/cosmological pass, observation, novelty, or publication claim follows.

principal_and_slice_health_contract.effective_inverse_metric: A_phi^munu=C g^munu-C_X d^mu phi d^nu phi
principal_and_slice_health_contract.limits: These are local principal and Legendre conditions only; lower-order tachyons, boundary fluxes, the metric constraints/evolution block, the universal-matter characteristics, and nonlinear cutoff control remain outside the proof.
principal_and_slice_health_contract.slice_sufficient_conditions: C>0, K_inv>0, K_ADM>0, and Y0>0 give a common local ADM time covector, a positive scalar kinetic Hessian, and positive completed-square spatial coefficients for the scalar principal block.
principal_and_slice_health_contract.spatial_eigenvalues: Two transverse eigenvalues are C and the gradient-longitudinal eigenvalue is C K_inv/K_ADM.

remaining_obligations: freeze the global P(X), V(phi), A(phi,chi), parameter domain, boundary conditions, and EFT cutoff without post-hoc health tuning
derive the complete metric-scalar-matter ADM kinetic and Hamiltonian system, including lapse/shift constraints and matter characteristics
prove a lower bound for the total physical Hamiltonian and constraint-compatible boundary fluxes on a realized domain
prove no ghosts, no gradient instabilities, and common causal hyperbolicity for every realized Solar, galaxy, cluster, and cosmological background
show that evolution preserves the Legendre, energy, and principal inequalities without crossing C=0, K_inv=0, or K_ADM=0
solve one source-supported parameter set and test the same-action motion, lensing, Solar, GW, and cosmological predictions

checks.statement: The ADM split gives X=(v_phi^2-s_phi^2)/2.
The lapse-normalized phi momentum is C v_phi.
The lapse-normalized chi momentum is Y0 v_chi.
The phi Legendre Hessian is K_ADM=C+v_phi^2 C_X.
The chi Legendre Hessian is Y0.
The scalar velocity Hessian has no phi-chi cross block.
The canonical density separates into lapse and scalar momentum-density terms.
The scalar normal Hamiltonian density has the frozen expanded form.
The normal Hamiltonian density equals T_munu n^mu n^nu.
The homogeneous scalar Hamiltonian reproduces the bound FLRW energy density.
The inverse phi momentum Hessian is 1/K_ADM where the Legendre map is regular.
The inverse chi momentum Hessian is 1/Y0.
The chosen normal coefficient is K_ADM.
The normal-spatial principal coefficient retains the exact background-gradient term.
The raw longitudinal spatial coefficient is C-C_X s^2.
Completing the time-space square yields the Schur spatial coefficient.
The longitudinal Schur eigenvalue is C K_inv/K_ADM.
The invariant effective-metric determinant is C^3 K_inv.
The illustrative mass gate contributes (1+u)(1-7u) to homogeneous energy.
The gate energy contribution changes sign at u=1/7.
The frozen Q bound is exactly the zero-energy boundary for u>1/7.
For finite positive rho_base, the energy chi^2 ceiling scales as X^-4.
K_ADM reduces to K_inv on a homogeneous slice.
The scalar shift density vanishes when both projected shift derivatives vanish.
